title: Stop the GIF skill from building the web bundle twice

source.anchor: then build that recorded tree — here, `pnpm run build && pnpm run build:web`

task:
Problem: .agents/skills/record-browser-gif/SKILL.md:29 tells the recorder to build the recorded tree with `pnpm run build && pnpm run build:web`. In package.json the `build` script is `npm run build:lib && npm run build:web` (`node -e "console.log(require('./package.json').scripts.build)"`), so the skill's command runs the Vite web build twice on every staging pass, and a reader takes from it that `pnpm run build` alone would leave the browser bundle unbuilt, which is false. The skill's own evidence-chain rule (SKILL.md:29, "A GIF recorded against another commit's build misattributes the evidence") is what makes the exact build command load-bearing.

Required: replace the command with `pnpm run build` and state in the same sentence that it emits the package libs and the web bundle, so the reader knows why one command suffices. Change nothing else in the skill.

Constraints: skill markdown only; do not change package.json scripts; the skills tree has no Chinese counterparts; mechanical, local doc edit under the Agent Note exemption. The queue's mandatory coverage run names dsh-skill-filesystem, the package that loads skill directories; it guards that package, not this edit, and passes before and after.

acceptance.run: ! grep -q 'pnpm run build && pnpm run build:web' .agents/skills/record-browser-gif/SKILL.md
